## found() function

A key's value was read: its cuts, when the read stopped short of the whole answer (a cap, fewer  days than asked), in the order a retention reads them; what it searched, when it depends on the  key. Typed by its value, so that `envelope` infers the loader's value type.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function found<V>(value: V, extras?: {
    readonly cuts?: readonly Cut[];
    readonly coverage?: Coverage;
}): Answer<V>;
```
